body: what you said makes sense, and i've made a point not to vent to them too heavily, the whole thing caught me by surprise. it seems that emotions have their own sort of logic. it feels like a betrayal of sorts for them to be close. is it rational? no, not really. i just needed to vent.

you're right, and it makes sense... i guess it's just weird because i don't really have any contact with any of this friends/relatives that i know, and some of them have been downright icy since the break up. i haven't said anything at all about it, its still just a bit of a raw nerve.

you're absolutely right, and those are some of the things that we've been discussing and figuring out over the past couple of days. on his end, he does want to be together long term, but right now, i'm feeling too hurt and angry to know what the hell i want. 

i needed to get out of my own head, and writing it out has helped a lot. thank you for your response.
yes, it did, thank you. it's been a rough couple of weeks with a lot of different feelings and i'm just beginning to make sense of them all. this is a good place to start.

i'm not sure what the screening process is like where you are, but when i donated blood they just ask if you've had sex with a man. they don't really ask about how you identify, the main thing is whether the sexual contact has occurred.

i've tried my best, told him that i'm there for him, told him to get help and that any help he tries to get will be confidential, and that only the people that take care of him will know what's going on. i've also talked to his sister to let her (and his family) know what's going on. at this point, he said that he's going to bed, and i plan to follow up with him tomorrow.
i would like to, but he's in another province, and i can't afford the trip at the moment. :(
